rows.grounds: imperative address directing the listener to attend
object of hearing; refers to a supreme mantra-knowledge
qualifies mahāvidyāṃ; compound indicating efficacy at the appointed time

items.question: What specific great knowledge is to be heard as effective at the proper time?
premises: The goddess is directly addressed to listen.
A great knowledge is presented as the object of hearing.
That great knowledge accomplishes results at the proper time.
items.inference: The speaker is about to reveal a great knowledge characterized by timely efficacy.
uncertainties: The precise ritual or doctrinal content of the mahāvidyā is not specified in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: Listen, O goddess, to the great knowledge that accomplishes its aim at the proper time.
